\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-69},
  title = {CodeCarbon's figure is reported as an estimate},
  date = {2026-10-05},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Energy Efficiency, Experiment Tracking},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {\texttt{train} measures only the model fit with CodeCarbon's \texttt{OfflineEmissionsTracker}, in \texttt{process} mode and against the Spanish grid, with its settings in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml}.
The row goes to \texttt{reports/\allowbreak{}emissions/\allowbreak{}<variant>.\allowbreak{}csv} and into the variant's MLflow run.
Every place that shows the figure calls it an estimate, and variants are compared within one run on one machine.
The estimate was checked once against the RAPL energy counter.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Permanent RAPL read access on the training laptop: unprivileged power readings are a known side channel, and RAPL counts the whole package, not the process.
\item Compare the variants on fit seconds alone: drops the energy comparison the issue and the rubric ask for.
\item The online tracker: it geolocates the machine and would write a contributor's location into a tracked file.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} On our machines CodeCarbon cannot read a power counter and falls back to a model: a constant for the RAM plus a share of the CPU's rated power.
Its figure is therefore a fit time multiplied by a machine-specific constant.
It ranks variants fairly within one run and is no reading in watt-hours that holds across machines.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI found the limitation by reading CodeCarbon's source and measuring on the laptop and on a GitHub runner, before it wrote the module.
The issue and the course demo had assumed a measurement.
It recommended the estimate with a one-off check, and Lukas chose that.
It did not obtain RAPL access by another route that was open to it.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-05 on issue \#38.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/modeling/energy.py}{\texttt{energy.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/rapl_validation_results.txt}{\texttt{rapl\_\allowbreak{}validation\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/model-card.md}{model card}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/68}{PR \#68}.},
